name: Laguna Dalga (Spain)
description: White field with a red triangle with its base along the hoist and its apex at the fly, charged with a white knight's helmet.
history: The arms and flag of Laguna Dalga were approved simultaneously and published in the Boletín Oficial de Castilla y León on 3 August 1999; the flag is rectangular, of proportions 2:3, formed of a white cloth with a red triangle.

features.role: triangle with its base along the hoist and its apex at the fly
